contentPattern: 1 column. Row 1: heading (H2) followed by any always-visible body (paragraphs, links). Optional Row 2 (2 cells): [trigger text | hidden details content] rendered as <details>/<summary>. Family page: Row 1 = H2 'How do I get help for a Veteran who's in crisis?'; Row 2 = 'Find out how to get support anytime, day or night' | paragraphs + bold lead-ins + ul of tel/sms/chat links. Variant B (health-care, housing): Row 1 only = H2 + p + p>a 'Get help if you're homeless or at risk of becoming homeless'. Absent on life-insurance. Strip sr-only 'Information Alert' prefix.
